subject: SCCs: scope mapping and operator-access playbook request
snippet: Follow-up on in-region processing scope, emergency operator access, backups/RPO, and the SCCs mapping template.
messages:
From: Elise Durand <elise.dpo@acmehealth.eu>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.eu>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Initial compliance checklist - in-region processing clarifications

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the checklist you sent last week. Our privacy team needs two follow-ups before we can sign the SCCs appendix:

1) Scope mapping: can you provide a granular mapping that shows which parts of processing (model inference, logs, backups, telemetry) are guaranteed to remain in EU jurisdictions? We need exported evidence we can attach to our DPA.

2) Operator access / emergency access policy: the legal team wants concrete controls for any temporary operator access from non-EU staff. Specifically: justifications for access, approval workflow, proof of auditability, and details on whether remote support sessions are allowed (and how sessions are recorded or blocked).

3) Backups & RPO: we need your practical RPO/RTO for customer backups stored in-region and your deletion verification flow (how you evidence deletion for retained backups).

Can you send a short operational playbook (we just need 1-2 pages per item) and any templates you use for SCCs mapping? If you have a diagram of KMS ownership/keyflow that would be ideal.

Appreciate a target reply by end of week — our board is reviewing the SCCs on Friday.

Best,
Elise
Data Protection Officer
Acme Health

---

(Attachment: none in this message)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Durand <elise.dpo@acmehealth.eu>
Cc: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.eu>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SCCs: scope mapping and operator-access playbook request

Hi Elise,

Thanks — understood. Short answer: yes, we can provide the artifacts you requested. Long answer: see quick summary below and I will attach a concise operational playbook and the SCCs mapping template by EOD Thursday.

- Scope mapping: Redwood supports "in-region" inference and storage for EU customers. Processing layers we can guarantee to remain in-region: model inference workers (inference GPU pool), encrypted customer artifacts & snapshots stored on in-region block storage, and controlled backups retained in-region. Telemetry (anonymized aggregates) may be routed to our global control plane for observability; we can provide a toggle to disable telemetry export where required. I will include a table showing each artifact and the hosting region + retention policy.

- Operator access / emergency access: we operate a documented emergency access flow for cross-border operator assistance: temporary access requires a business-justified request, approval from the customer's authorized admin (or our designated security contact), a JIT (just-in-time) ephemeral credential with MFA, and mandatory session recording where sessions touch customer data. For EU-only contracts we can require that sessions be observed/assisted only by EU-based operators OR use a privileged remote-debug proxy that redacts PII. We will provide the exact approval workflow, RBAC roles involved, and sample audit logs.

- Backups & RPO: For in-region backups we offer configurable RPO tiers. Standard in-region tier: RPO 24h, RTO 4h for restore orchestration; optional premium: RPO 1h, RTO 1h with reserved snapshot capacity. Deletion verification: we run verifiable deletion jobs that emit a signed deletion receipt; we can provide the receipts and a summary CSV showing object IDs, deletion timestamp, and KMS-wrapped key destruction confirmation.

I'll loop in Naomi (privacy ops) and Marcus (infrastructure) to prepare the artifacts in the format you requested. Expect: (1) 2-page operational playbook, (2) KMS keyflow diagram, (3) SCCs mapping spreadsheet.

Jonas Weber
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

(Attachments to follow)

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:10:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: SCCs: scope mapping and operator-access playbook request

Naomi / Marcus — forwarding Acme's ask (see below). They want a short operational playbook and an SCCs mapping spreadsheet plus a KMS diagram. Target: EOD Thursday so they can present to the board Friday.

Key items we should include in the package:
- 2-page "In-region operations" playbook: guaranteed hosting boundaries, telemetry toggle, backup retention & deletion receipts, example logs for audit. (Naomi — can you draft the playbook language and the sample audit log format?)
- "Operator access" appendix: step-by-step JIT access flow, approver roles, session recording/telemetry redaction options, and legal-friendly wording we can provide for contract annex. (Marcus — can you confirm the JIT implementation and whether we can enforce EU-based operator constraint for a customer? If not, propose the privileged-redaction proxy approach.)
- SCCs mapping spreadsheet: columns for artifact, processing step, region, retention, evidence artifact id, contract clause ref.

Also flag any known technical limitations (e.g., third-party telemetry exporters that may cross borders) so we can be transparent.

I'll draft the playbook cover doc and assemble the diagrams once you confirm.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Durand <elise.dpo@acmehealth.eu>
Cc: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.eu>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 17:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SCCs: scope mapping and operator-access playbook request

Hi Elise (and Acme legal),

Attached are the artifacts we discussed: a compact operational playbook, the SCCs mapping template filled with example rows for common artifacts, and a KMS keyflow diagram. Summary of the deliverables and the commitments we can make in-contract: 

1) In-region scope guarantees (contract language suggested):
   - Inference and primary customer data storage will be hosted in EU region(s) specified in the contract.
   - Backups created by Redwood for restoration purposes will be stored in the same in-region storage cluster and will be subject to the RPO tier elected by the customer.

2) Operator access & emergency support:
   - Temporary operator access requires (a) documented customer approval from an authorized admin, (b) RBAC-based JIT credentials with 1-time MFA, and (c) mandatory audit logging.
   - For EU-only contracts we can add a contractual control: either enforce that only EU-based operators are allowed OR use our privileged-redaction proxy for remote sessions (the proxy prevents raw PII exposure and records a redaction-proof audit trace).

3) Backups & deletion verification:
   - Standard: RPO 24h / RTO 4h. Premium: RPO 1h / RTO 1h with reserved snapshot capacity.
   - Deletion receipts: we provide a signed deletion receipt CSV (object ids, deletion ts, KMS-wrapped key destroy token). We can deliver a bundle of receipts on-demand as evidence for specific deletion requests.

4) Telemetry & control plane:
   - We will provide a telemetry toggle that prevents export of tenant-level telemetry outside EU. Aggregated/anonymous metrics required for platform health may still feed our control plane; this can be disabled per contract.

Deliverables attached: 
- redwood-inregion-ops-playbook.pdf (2 pages) — operational commitments and evidence artifacts
- kms-keyflow-diagram.png — key custody diagram showing customer-managed KMS + Redwood service keys and wrap/unwrap flows
- sccs-mapping-template.xlsx — spreadsheet template with example mappings and evidence id column

If these match your needs we suggest adding two short contract clauses: one enumerating the hosting & backup guarantees and one specifying the operator-access constraints (EU-only operators OR privileged-redaction proxy). If Acme wants a DocuSign-ready annex, we can prepare it and include the exact clause language.

Next steps: please confirm which operator-access constraint you prefer and which RPO tier you'd like for backups so we can finalize the SCCs appendix wording.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-inregion-ops-playbook.pdf (2 pages); kms-keyflow-diagram.png; sccs-mapping-template.xlsx
